# ADR-3049: A05: Debug mode configuration flag for environment 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Debug modes leak stacks and admin tools.

## Decision

Production configuration SHALL not enable a debug mode configuration flag for environment 1 (A05-1).

## Consequences

Deploy gates reject debug=true in prod.
